$comment: Cases that do not match Node yet, by target, each with its cause. The diff run reports them without failing, and fails when one matches Node so it is removed here. Owners: the Kotlin translator (src/kotlin.ts) and runtime (kit-android runtime).

swift.1031-map-key-nullish-refused: Refused (build error): a Map key that may be null or undefined both, which no form holds apart (`Form.element` is a Map's value only; lang.ts nullishSlots checkNested).
swift.1046-library-symbol-converts: Swift's library code makes `Symbol(desc)` an untyped value as its property-key string (`jsSymbol(String)` → "@@desc#n"), so its typeof is "string" and String() prints the key; only a slot typed `symbol` holds a JSSymbol. Kotlin matches Node.
swift.1064-define-property-during-construction: Refused (build error): Object.defineProperty on `this` in its class's constructor making a declared field an accessor, read-only, hidden or fixed: the constructor and field initializers read the Swift field directly (Q4: literal keys after construction only).
swift.247-missing-values-throw: A module const read before its declaration runs, and a member of undefined or null read, set or called, trap instead of throwing ReferenceError or TypeError (Swift translator, quality step 4).
swift.363-operator-pipe: Refused (build error, declared limit Q10): an app generic class's instance held with `any` as its type argument (`let stream: Stream<any> = this` in the overloaded `pipe`'s `any` implementation, `Stream<T>` as `Stream<Any?>`), which Swift's invariant generic class can't hold; the hint: hold it with its own type argument, and type an overload implementation's parameters and result as its overloads do (Swift translator).
swift.620-interface-identity: Refused: an untyped object converted to an interface's class (a copy) where the code compares it by identity, looks it up as a key, or a callee keeps it (preflight, src/sharing.ts).
swift.626-array-parameter-mutation: Refused: an untyped or typed array given to a number[] parameter its callee writes to is converted into a copy (preflight, src/sharing.ts).
swift.662-untyped-array-parameter: Refused: an untyped array given to a number[] or string[] parameter its callee writes to is converted into a copy (preflight, src/sharing.ts); Kotlin passes it as is only when its elements already are the type, which a build cannot know.
swift.862-json-unrepresentable: A lone surrogate JSON.parse reads from an escape becomes U+FFFD, since Swift strings hold only valid Unicode; and JSON.stringify recurses per nesting level, so 5000 nested arrays exceed the stack (RangeError) where V8 writes them iteratively (Swift runtime limits).
swift.863-string-lone-surrogate-literal: A string literal holding a lone surrogate is refused: a Swift string cannot hold one (Swift translator).
swift.891-generic-class-fields-as-interface: Refused (build error, declared limit Q10): a generic class whose field or getter typed by its type parameter meets a generic interface's field, held as the interface; Swift can't overload a property by its type; the hint: declare the interface's field with a concrete type, or read it through a method (Swift translator).
swift.934-define-property-run-time-key: Refused: Object.defineProperty (or defineProperties with a map of keys known only at run time) with a key known only at run time, on an untyped object, where the program holds an object of a class with declared fields untyped: a typed field keeps no descriptor.
swift.939-regexp-unset-groups-typed-callback: Refused (build error): a function value whose element parameter is declared `string` (no undefined), given to visit strings a pattern's unset group may leave undefined; declaring it `string | undefined` compiles (lang.ts unsetGroupTyping.typedCallback).
swift.945-regexp-lone-surrogates: A match that starts or ends inside a surrogate pair, or an input holding a lone surrogate, gives a lone surrogate, which a Swift String cannot hold: it becomes U+FFFD (documented limit, like 862; Swift runtime).
swift.952-regexp-unset-group-object-values: Silent wrong value: an unset group's split element read back through Object.values of an object literal (`Object.values({ p: s.split(re) })`) is "", not undefined (the literal's field is typed string[]).
swift.953-replace-function-string-pattern-refu: Refused (build error): replace/replaceAll given a replacement that may be a function (or is untyped) for a pattern that may be a string (typed string, `string | RegExp`, untyped, or asserted from untyped); a RegExp pattern takes a function (lang.ts unsupportedPattern).
swift.994-nullish-elements-untyped-refused: Refused (build error): an array, Map or Set whose elements are held apart as null and undefined (`JSNullish<T>`, observed) placed where script holds it untyped (an `any`/`unknown` slot, a field or element no type reads, an unknown callee's argument), which may write any value into it; typed↔untyped containers are S5 (value-states.ts nullish, Forms.untypedPlacements).

kotlin.1031-map-key-nullish-refused: Refused (build error): a Map key that may be null or undefined both, which no form holds apart (`Form.element` is a Map's value only; lang.ts nullishSlots checkNested).

kotlin.1070-null-into-typed-callback: Throws where JavaScript carries null: script calling a function typed to take an object with null; Kotlin's function adapters don't carry it yet (S5-4, Q7).
kotlin.252-prototype-method-calls: A built-in's prototype method called with call or apply (`Array.prototype.slice.call(list, 1)`) is refused, test262 cluster 2 (Kotlin translator).
kotlin.254-destructuring-assignment: A rest element in a destructuring assignment (`[first, ...others] = list`) is refused, test262 cluster 8 (Kotlin translator).

kotlin.953-replace-function-string-pattern-refu: Refused (build error): replace/replaceAll given a replacement that may be a function (or is untyped) for a pattern that may be a string (typed string, `string | RegExp`, untyped, or asserted from untyped); a RegExp pattern takes a function (lang.ts unsupportedPattern).
kotlin.994-nullish-elements-untyped-refused: Refused (build error): an array, Map or Set whose elements are held apart as null and undefined (`JSNullish<T>`, observed) placed where script holds it untyped (an `any`/`unknown` slot, a field or element no type reads, an unknown callee's argument), which may write any value into it; typed↔untyped containers are S5 (value-states.ts nullish, Forms.untypedPlacements).
kotlin.1072-untyped-callback-identity: Identity lost (runtime): a module function held untyped is a `jsFunction(n, ::f)` made at each read; `jsFunction1(held)` read back typed is a new lambda (it does not unwrap `JSFunction.original`), and Set/Map keys compare `JSAdapted` originals but not `JSFunction` ones. S5-5 checkpoint: needs a runtime change (Dynamic.kt jsFunctionN, Collections.kt keys) or one wrapper per function.
